snippet.title: The Atrium - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Atrium is a roguelite mining game with an eerie, atmospheric vibe where you dig deeper each day, using resources you mine to craft powerful tools and upgrades, until you are strong enough to reach the end of the cave before it all collapses on you.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4894820/The_Atrium/
